method: Walk the running product as a user from its actual entry points; treat source expectations below only as a checklist.
Start with a fresh no-device profile, then a representative initialized QA device, then model/mode comparisons, then platform-exclusive lanes.
Append missing capabilities and observation/screenshot records; do not delete or silently collapse baseline features.
One screenshot may support multiple feature IDs only when each claimed control/state is visible; record capture coverage explicitly.
Absent controls need a recorded model, firmware, platform, flags and prerequisite state before a runtime-absence conclusion.
A provider/network/service failure is a blocked observation, not proof a capability is absent.

runtime_prerequisites.required: A running Suite build matching the audited source; record web/Electron/native build and source SHA.
A task-owned isolated QA browser profile and working screenshot capture; shared browser automation follows the parent session tools.
A task-owned trezor-user-env service, Bridge and firmware emulator with its available model/version inventory.
Only disposable QA fixtures, with known empty/funded/history/pending states; no real user accounts.
Local/regtest or deterministic mocked network/provider responses for forms requiring balance, UTXOs, history or quotes. Record mocks as mocks.
Actual Electron runtime for tray/startup/Tor/native-window/biometric controls; web UI does not establish those.
Actual Android/iOS app runtime for native-only tracker, sharing, biometrics and navigation; a mobile browser viewport is not native parity.

firmware_track_policy.source_defaults: PlaywrightProjectBuilder uses 1-latest for T1B1 and 2-latest for other models.
firmware_track_policy.source_exploratory: The current exploratory config explicitly requests 2-main for T3W1, T3T1, T3B1 and T2T1.
firmware_track_policy.runtime_rule: Enumerate available firmwares from the running service, resolve aliases, and record actual selected versions. Compare latest release baseline with main separately; do not silently mix tracks in a model comparison.
variants: Universal versus Bitcoin-only where supported and available
PIN protected versus unprotected without capturing values

focus: No explicit rotation support in current component
Host PIN matrix entry without capturing values
No separate Model enum entry in current trezor-user-env-link
Original packaging=0 default differs; use an actual available older firmware/device only if runtime inventory supports it
Do not label T3B1 observations as direct T2B1 hardware verification

model_comparison_checks.expectation: Record app-rendered product name, internal model and actual firmware version/track; do not store unique device IDs, sessions or raw feature packets. T2B1 and T3B1 are both Safe 3; source normalization maps T2B1 to T3B1.

T1B1 defaults to 24 words without the general selector; T2T1 defaults to 12 words; T3B1/T3T1/T3W1 default to single-share SLIP39. The original T2B1 package with unit_packaging=0 defaults to 12 words. Confirm runtime packaging/firmware; do not assume every Safe 3 is the same.

T1B1 has host-side word-count/method flow; standard is selectable for 24 words, while 12/18 words route to advanced recovery. Other supported models use on-device recovery input. Capture choosers before secret entry.
Single-share Shamir option is gated by firmware >=2.7.1 in the desktop/web selector. Compare firmware support independently from model name.
Current desktop/web rotation component explicitly allows T2T1 and T3T1; a display_rotation field alone is not proof of support on T3B1 or other models.

Visibility is capability-driven: Capability_Brightness and Capability_Haptic. Record the specific capability names and UI state; do not infer them solely from a product name. Browser UI observation cannot verify physical light output or vibration.

Auto-lock requires the relevant numeric firmware field and PIN state in containing settings. Language selector requires more than one supported device language. Firmware/type changes can alter the available choices.

Known model metadata and homescreen support determine enabled actions and formats. T2T1 additionally requires a reported homescreen_format; compare gallery/upload UI without assuming all models share formats.

Source enables hardware authenticity for Safe 3/5/7 models and disables it for Model One/Model T. T3W1 has additional secure-component checks and version-dependent MCU expectations. Emulator UI or simulated attestation is not physical-device authenticity verification.

THP automatic connection requires stored credentials; Bluetooth requires a real supported transport path. Trezor emulator/Bridge coverage does not alone establish physical Bluetooth pairing or OS cleanup behavior.
